title: webhook-runner hook configuration
description: Configuration for a webhook-runner hook. Place this file as hook.json inside a named directory under the hooks root, next to the mandatory Dockerfile that bakes the hook's code into its image.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this hook does.

command.description: Optional override of the image's CMD, passed to docker run after the image name. Every hook runs the image webhook-runner builds from the Dockerfile in its directory (tagged by content hash) — code is baked in and immutable per run; when command is omitted, the image's CMD/ENTRYPOINT runs.

tests.description: Test commands for the hook's scripts. Each entry is an argv array that `webhook-runner test` runs in the hook's built image, so tests exercise exactly the baked code (copy test files into the image and set WORKDIR so relative paths resolve). Tests run without the hook's env, secrets, or payload and must be self-contained; they never run when the hook is triggered.

networks.description: Docker networks to attach the container to.

env.description: Extra environment variables. Values may reference secrets as ${NAME}, resolved from the hook's sops-encrypted secrets.sops.env first, then the runner host's environment (expanded at container start; unresolvable names expand to "" with a warning). Entries of secrets.sops.env are also injected into the container directly, with explicit env entries winning on conflict. HOOK_PAYLOAD_FILE, HOOK_HEADERS_FILE, HOOK_ID, and HOOK_RUN_ID are reserved.

user.description: User/UID to run the container as (--user flag).

workdir.description: Working directory inside the container (--workdir flag).

timeout.description: Go duration for the container timeout (e.g. "5m", "30s"). Default: 5m.

synchronous.description: When true, the server holds the HTTP response open until the container exits. Default: false (returns 202 immediately).

extra_docker_args.description: Additional raw arguments passed to docker run.

api_key.description: API key for bearer-token authentication. Checked against the X-API-Key header (or api_key_header). May reference a secret as ${NAME}, resolved from the hook's sops-encrypted secrets.sops.env first, then the runner host's environment; if the reference is unresolvable the hook fails closed (all requests rejected). Recommended for most hooks.

api_key_header.description: HTTP header to read the API key from. Default: X-API-Key.

public_key.description: Base64 or hex-encoded Ed25519 public key. When set, incoming requests must include a valid Ed25519 signature of the body in the signature header.

signature_header.description: HTTP header containing the signature. Default: X-Signature-Ed25519 for public_key auth, X-Hub-Signature-256 for legacy HMAC.

secret.description: Legacy: shared secret for HMAC-SHA256 signature verification. Prefer api_key or public_key.

enabled.description: Enable GitHub commit status updates for this hook.

context.description: The status context string (e.g. "ci/deploy"). Required when enabled is true.

target_url.description: Optional URL linked from the GitHub status check.
